name: fynns-ui-consume
title: Install @fynns/ui via GitHub Packages (LLM contract)
description: Machine-readable API for agents: add @fynn7/ui-design-core from GitHub Packages and wire Vite/tsconfig alias @fynns/ui. Do not use git submodule for day-to-day consume. Short user prompts still require reading this contract before UI work.
rules: On any short prompt involving @fynns/ui / fynns UI / Collapsible (etc.), read llm/CONSUME.md before writing app code.
Paste llm/consumer-cursor-rule.mdc into the consumer .cursor/rules/ (see llm/CONSUMER_TREATY.md) so agents obey without opening AGENTS.

Default destination app chrome: DestinationAppShell (sandbox Layout templates #layouts-demo-shell) unless the user specifies another template. Never greenfield from standalone NavigationRail. When densified to NavigationRail, default labelVisibility="labeled" (always show labels).

ClippedNavShell (slot API): navMode must match nav children (drawer→NavigationDrawer, rail→NavigationRail). Never leave a labeled drawer in a rail-width track. Prefer DestinationAppShell so agents need not hand-sync. nav = destinations only — never wiki/page body/forms/Chat/Preview in the nav track (those go in children/main or aside/EndAside). "Clipped" = M3 chrome topology under a full-bleed TopAppBar — not text clipping; diagnose data-nav / track width / which slot holds odd copy before restyling .fynns-*. NavigationDrawer body siblings (Item/Group/Headline/destination-density SearchBar/tools) use --fynns-navdrawer-section-gap (4dp) — never wrap destinations in .fynns-unit-stack (16dp). See llm/CONSUMER_TREATY.md squashed drawer + wrong shell slot + destination gap.

Inspector / Surface labeled rows: use ControlStack + ControlRow (label | controls); sibling controls in .fynns-control-cluster; supporting/timestamp copy via ControlBlock description or FieldHint — never hand-rolled flex that stacks name+hint on the left while ToggleGroup/Button float mid/right. Live: sandbox #rhythm + #form-recipe. See llm/CONSUMER_TREATY.md ad-hoc Surface / inspector row chaos.

Content density: path/link/bookmark catalogs = one List of ListItems (headline + supportingText path + trailing ghost sm IconButtons). Never one padded Surface/Card per entry; never put row actions under the text or as a filled danger disk. Interactive ListItem trailing is outside the row button. Live: sandbox #list. See AGENTS.md Content density + llm/CONSUMER_TREATY.md fat Surface / Card per catalog row.

WYSIWYG / surface sync: sandbox Globals/Preview/Layouts resting look is the consumer default; never restyle .fynns-* in the app. SANDBOX_DEFAULT_OVERRIDES must stay empty. Core: never sandbox-only drop of an exported symbol — atomic delete (unexport+source+demo+BREAKING_PURGE). npm run check:wysiwyg.
Consume as GitHub Packages npm dependency @fynn7/ui-design-core + Vite source alias @fynns/ui → node_modules/@fynn7/ui-design-core/src/index.ts.
DO add @fynn7/ui-design-core to package.json dependencies. Do NOT depend on @fynns/ui or @fynns/ui-design-core as registry package names. Do NOT use git submodule for day-to-day consume.
NEVER publish-install from the public npmjs registry for this package — registry is https://npm.pkg.github.com (@fynn7 scope).
Keep resolve.dedupe [react, react-dom] so package source shares the app React instance.
Do not modify files inside node_modules/@fynn7/ui-design-core for consumer features (bump package version / file: link instead). There is no consume:sync / consume:watch worktree mirror.

Before any @fynns/ui UI work: run consume --check (dependency + .npmrc + alias; fails if legacy submodule tree remains). Re-paste consumer-cursor-rule.mdc when the treaty updates (installer does not overwrite).
Consumer tsconfig compilerOptions.target and lib must be ES2022 or later (tsc follows @fynns/ui into design-system sources; ES2020 fails on APIs such as String.replaceAll).
Do not import purged symbols (toast/Toaster/Popover/UnitStack/…). Dialog/Drawer/Textarea/Tabs/InlineAlert are restored — see llm/BREAKING_PURGE.md. Use snackbar + SnackbarHost for transient feedback.
App entry must createRoot and render App (CSS-only main.tsx is a fail).
Never hand-roll Collapsible chrome or use @radix-ui/* / sonner.

Collapsible/Card chrome: default card; when nesting a surface-owning child (CodeBlock/Surface/canvas/BusyRegion) pass chrome="plain" — body uses --fynns-layout-nest-gap (pad + gap); plain ≠ flush — never cancel nest-gap with negative margins. Outside those shells use .fynns-nest.

CodeBlock chrome (strict): titled default requires non-empty label (filename); omit/empty label throws. No title → variant="plain" (frame + float copy). Never label="" to fake a headless titled block.

CodeBlock language (strict): label is chrome only — not a language detector. Always pass language (or highlightProfile / registered id) matching the source (e.g. label="system-prompt.xml" + language="xml"). Omitted/unknown language → plain mono. Built-ins: ts/js/py/cpp/css/json/xml/html/bash/…. Fill editable hosts → autoGrow={false}. Authority: llm/AGENT_INTERFACES.md.

API-only: pass props/children/labels to @fynns/ui; never wrap keep-set primitives in consumer restyles or local .fynns-* overrides. If the keep-set cannot meet the ask, tell the user explicitly to implement in fynns_ui_design_core first. Chat containers must stay ≥ --fynns-radius-22 unless the user explicitly asks squarer (see AGENTS.md Hard rules).

ChatMessage Markdown (prefer core): use ChatMessage markdown={md} or <ChatMarkdown source={md} /> (L2 GFM subset). When markdown is set it wins over children. Never pass raw Markdown strings as bare children. Authority: AGENTS.md Parity note (markdown/GFM) + consumer-cursor-rule.mdc.
If build uses tsc, add vite-env.d.ts with /// <reference types="vite/client" /> so CSS imports from @fynns/ui typecheck.
For preview/playground pages, mirror examples/sandbox/src/pages/*PreviewCanvas.tsx and skim AGENTS.md.
Shells (ClippedNavShell), token inspectors, Globals-style catalogs, and live draft GUIs: read llm/PERF.md before coding (no observer↔probe loops, no tip forests, lazy-mount dense sections).

install.description: Add @fynn7/ui-design-core (GitHub Packages), ensure .npmrc, wire Vite + tsconfig @fynns/ui. Requires NODE_AUTH_TOKEN or GITHUB_TOKEN with read:packages.

check.description: Validate dependency + .npmrc + @fynns/ui alias + no leftover submodule tree (exit 1 if incomplete).

wireOnly.description: Dependency already present; only patch .npmrc / Vite / tsconfig.

publish.description: Publish @fynn7/ui-design-core to GitHub Packages (CI: release or workflow_dispatch).

successCriteria: vite.config.* has resolve.alias["@fynns/ui"] pointing at that entry
vite resolve.dedupe includes react and react-dom
tsconfig paths map @fynns/ui to the same entry (when a tsconfig exists)
tsconfig target/lib are ES2022+ when the consumer runs tsc against @fynns/ui
no packages/fynns_ui_design_core (or gui/…) git submodule left as the alias target
import { Collapsible } from "@fynns/ui" typechecks / builds in the consumer
no imports of purged symbols listed in llm/BREAKING_PURGE.md
